title: Exploring the Parallel G-Quadruplex Nucleic Acid World: A Spectroscopic and Computational Investigation on the Binding of the c-myc Oncogene NHE III1 Region by the Phytochemical Polydatin.
authors: Greco, Francesca; Musumeci, Domenica; Borbone, Nicola; Falanga, Andrea Patrizia; D'Errico, Stefano; Terracciano, Monica; Piccialli, Ilaria; Roviello, Giovanni Nicola; Oliviero, Giorgia
one_liner_zh: 该文通过CD光谱和分子对接研究植物化合物白藜芦醇苷与c-myc启动子G-四链体DNA的结合，虽非典型TF-DNA体系，但属于蛋白/配体-DNA互作建模，方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: Trans-polydatin (tPD), the 3-beta-D-glucoside of the well-known nutraceutical trans-resveratrol, is a natural polyphenol with documented anti-cancer, anti-inflammatory, cardioprotective, and immunoregulatory effects. Considering the anticancer activity of tPD, in this work, we aimed to explore the binding properties of this natural compound with the G-quadruplex (G4) structure formed by the Pu22 [d(TGAGGGTGGGTAGGGTGGGTAA)] DNA sequence by exploiting CD spectroscopy and molecular docking simulations. Pu22 is a mutated and shorter analog of the G4-forming sequence known as Pu27 located in the promoter of the c-myc oncogene, whose overexpression triggers the metabolic changes responsible for cancer cells transformation. The binding of tPD with the parallel Pu22 G4 was confirmed by CD spectroscopy, which showed significant changes in the CD spectrum of the DNA and a slight thermal stabilization of the G4 structure. To gain a deeper insight into the structural features of the tPD-Pu22 complex, we performed an in silico molecular docking study, which indicated that the interaction of tPD with Pu22 G4 may involve partial end-stacking to the terminal G-quartet and H-bonding interactions between the sugar moiety of the ligand and deoxynucleotides not included in the G-tetrads. Finally, we compared the experimental CD profiles of Pu22 G4 with the corresponding theoretical output obtained using DichroCalc, a web-based server normally used for the prediction of proteins' CD spectra starting from their ".pdb" file. The results indicated a good agreement between the predicted and the experimental CD spectra in terms of the spectral bands' profile even if with a slight bathochromic shift in the positive band, suggesting the utility of this predictive tool for G4 DNA CD investigations.
abstract_zh: 反式白藜芦醇苷 (trans-polydatin, tPD)，即众所周知的营养保健品反式白藜芦醇的3-β-D-葡萄糖苷，是一种天然多酚，具有已证实的抗癌、抗炎、心脏保护和免疫调节作用。鉴于tPD的抗癌活性，本研究旨在利用圆二色光谱 (CD spectroscopy) 和分子对接模拟，探讨该天然化合物与由Pu22 [d(TGAGGGTGGGTAGGGTGGGTAA)] DNA序列形成的G-四链体 (G-quadruplex, G4) 结构的结合特性。Pu22是位于c-myc癌基因启动子中的G4形成序列Pu27的突变且缩短的类似物，该基因的过表达触发导致癌细胞转化的代谢变化。tPD与平行Pu22 G4的结合通过CD光谱得到确认，结果显示DNA的CD光谱发生显著变化，并伴随G4结构的轻微热稳定性增强。为更深入了解tPD-Pu22复合物的结构特征，我们进行了计算机分子对接研究，结果表明tPD与Pu22 G4的相互作用可能涉及对末端G-四分体的部分末端堆叠，以及配体糖部分与未包含在G-四分体中的脱氧核苷酸之间的氢键相互作用。最后，我们将Pu22 G4的实验CD谱与使用DichroCalc（一种通常用于从“.pdb”文件预测蛋白质CD光谱的基于网络的服务器）获得的理论输出进行了比较。结果表明，预测的CD光谱与实验CD光谱在谱带轮廓方面具有良好一致性，尽管正带存在轻微红移，提示该预测工具在G4 DNA CD研究中的实用性。
